lines: Devil Worm
HRSSSSSSSSSSS!!!!!
Shikanosuke
Uwaaaaahh!!! S-Stupid Fuma~!! You said you'd handle it, but now I have to~!?
The Devil Worm growled and attacked Shikanosuke, who had jumped out into the tunnel half-crying.
Me
You're the right person for this job!! Now, Shikanosuke, shoot itー!!
Shikanosuke
Ugh~ ...If I get eaten, I'll become a ghost and haunt you~!! T-Take this!! Electric Jutsu: Multi-Spark!!!
*Bzz, bzz, bzz, bzzzz!!*
Countless lights flickered in the narrow tunnel.
And thenー
Devil Worm
HRSSSSSSSSSSS!!!??
Shikanosuke
N-No way!? My Ninja Art is working!?
The Devil Worm writhed like it was out of its mind.
After crashing its huge body against the walls all over, it finally turned away from Shikanosuke, who was supposed to be the tasty "prey," and escaped into the depths of the tunnel.
Hebiko
Amazing, Shikanosuke-chan!! But... Fuma-chan, what happened?
Hebiko tilted her head.
Shikanosuke's Electric Jutsu had its uses, but it wasn't very powerful, so it was poorly suited to combat.
Me
I told you, didn't I? It's a massive-bodied beast from the Devildom, but the important thing is it's still a worm.
Hebiko
You're talking about the characteristics you mentioned earlier?
Me
Yeah. The entire surface of a worm's body is all sensory organs.
Me
Each segment of their body has easily over a thousand sensory organs. Those organs sense touch, taste, and light.
Sana
Heeh, that many!? They look so featureless, but they've got a lot going on, huh.
Sana-san nodded, seemingly impressed by my explanation of worm trivia.
Shikanosuke
I-I see!! And my spark struck its sensitive areas and it got overwhelmed, right!!?
Me
Exactly. But it isn't hurt, it just ran away in panic. It should be back any minute.
Sana
Yeah, but it's enough if you're able to clear the path for a moment. Shikanosuke, Fuma, you're the best!!
Sana-san grinned broadly and ran down the tunnel ahead of us.
Sana
Now's our chance! I know the way, so follow me, you three!!
